name: YFlix Local
description: Independent YFlix.in provider for Nuvio. Server 1 calls the same PlayAPI backend used by the current YFlix frontend and returns working direct streams with required playback headers; DahmerMovies is temporarily filtered after device playback failures.

scrapers.name: YFlix · Server 1
scrapers.description: YFlix Server 1 (Multi Source): direct PlayAPI stream API using TMDB IDs. Returns current upstream streams and per-stream request headers, excluding the currently incompatible DahmerMovies route.
scrapers.author: YFlix Local
